subject: Animation
title: The Pixar-Disney Deal
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Pixar-Disney Deal.

hook.text: By 2004, Pixar had never made a flop. Disney's own animation studio had not had a hit in years.

buildup.text: Pixar's deal with Disney was expiring. Steve Jobs threatened to take Pixar to a rival distributor.

discovery.text: New Disney CEO Bob Iger realized losing Pixar would be catastrophic and proposed a full acquisition.

twist.text: Pixar's leaders demanded creative independence as a condition. Disney agreed to leave them alone.

climax.text: Disney bought Pixar for $7.4 billion in 2006 and put Ed Catmull in charge of all Disney animation.

punchline.text: The student bought the teacher and took over the school.

quiz.question: What condition did Pixar demand in the Disney acquisition?
options: That Disney shut down its own animation studio
Creative independence, with Disney agreeing not to interfere with Pixar's process
That all Disney films be made with CGI only
